MYSTERY
01 • WHAT IS ZENTRIX?

THE MYSTERY

MYSTERY SCIENCE TECHNOLOGY INNOVATION

A 24-hour hackathon set in the mysterious world of Nevermore Academy, where technology, creativity, and unconventional problem-solving come together.

Participants will face challenging problems that demand logical thinking, scientific exploration, technical skills, and innovative ideas. Like a mystery waiting to be uncovered, every challenge requires participants to observe, analyse, experiment, and discover the right solution.

Teams will have 24 hours to transform their concepts into working solutions, pushing their technical abilities, creativity, and teamwork to the limit. The event brings together the atmosphere of mystery, intelligence, science, and innovation, creating a unique environment where the unexpected becomes the starting point for something extraordinary.

Unconventional Challenges

Unique problem domains revealed through a mystic rolling-dice mechanism.

Deep Tech & Logic

Hardware, software, algorithmic depth, and intelligent system prototyping.

CYBER-GYROSCOPIC RUNES ACTIVE

THE-LAWS
06 • CODE OF ENGAGEMENT

THE LAWS OF THE GAME

All 15 official governance principles from the ZENTRIX brochure.

OFFICIAL AI PROTOCOL

AI TOOLS ARE ALLOWED.

"Participants are free to use AI tools, coding assistants, online resources, frameworks, libraries, APIs, and other digital tools during the hackathon."

BUT THE IMPLEMENTATION MUST BE YOURS.
15 STRICT POLICIES
Teams must consist of exactly 4 members. Inter-disciplinary and cross-year teams from registered institutions are permitted. All team details must be finalized prior to hackathon commencement.
All development must take place within the designated 24-hour hackathon window (11:00 AM on Day 1 to 11:00 AM on Day 2). No coding before the official start signal.
Working on existing codebases, pre-built applications, or pre-configured software templates is strictly prohibited. All repositories must be initialized fresh during the event.
Any direct copied code, unauthorized intellectual property, or misattributed work without proper open-source licensing attribution will lead to immediate disqualification.
Participants are freely encouraged to leverage state-of-the-art AI tools, LLMs, coding assistants, documentation, cloud APIs, and developer frameworks to maximize productivity.
While AI assistance is allowed, the architecture, integration, problem logic, and novel solution implementation must be understood and demonstrated by the team members.
Teams may brainstorm, sketch wireframes, and read research literature during the 48-hour preparation window, but no project code may be drafted prior to the official 11:00 AM start.
Publicly available open-source libraries, packages, and frameworks (e.g. npm, pip, PyTorch, React) are permitted provided they are documented and credited in the project README.
Teams must present a live, functional demonstration of their prototype to the judging panel during both evaluation rounds. Video-only submissions are not accepted.
Final code repository links, presentation slide decks, and project summary documents must be submitted before 10:00 AM on Day 2. Late submissions will incur penalty deductions.
Respectful collaboration, competitive integrity, and sportsmanship are mandatory. Mutual aid during general technical blocks is encouraged while maintaining team confidentiality.
Any malicious attempt to disrupt college network infrastructure, perform cyberattacks, or tamper with peer devices will lead to instant expulsion and institutional notification.
All participants must abide by the professional code of conduct of Sri Sairam Engineering College and IEEE Industrial Electronics Society. ID cards must be worn at all times.
The evaluations, marks, and final rankings determined by the official judging panel and IES committee are binding and final. No appeals or external lobbying will be entertained.
Violation of any rule, unethical behavior, non-adherence to deadlines, or misrepresentation will result in immediate disqualification and forfeiture of participation certificates.
